title: Battlefield 6 temporarily made free and introduced an UFO easter egg that many disliked
excerpt: Not everyone likes the direction the shooter is taking.
content:
Not everyone likes the direction the shooter is taking.

The fifth season of Battlefield 6 started in October. The first content update, called "Siege of Las Vegas," added a battle pass, new maps Vegas Strip and Area 51, and expanded the arsenal with new weapon models.

The creators of Battlefield 6 introduced a new Free Trial promotion, during which players can get acquainted with the shooter for free — it will last until October 20 (Tuesday). Until the same date, discounts will apply to the base edition and the Game of the Year version.

In addition, Battlefield 6 developers will collaborate with the Dead Space franchise this month. The promo campaign has already begun: a website styled in the 2000s has been launched, and players have found an UFO easter egg in Area 51. What they saw did not please many.

Dissatisfied players believe that the developers are turning Battlefield 6 into Call of Duty; they also criticize the small number of new maps and point to strange new skins — there is an opinion that they were made using artificial intelligence.

By the end of 2026, Battlefield 6 developers plan to release two more major updates with new weapons, events, vehicles, and maps. They also plan to add a server browser.
